Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R). 
Assertion (A): For a norm-referenced test designed to maximize discrimination, items with a difficulty index around 0.50 are most preferred. 
Reason (R): Items with a difficulty level of 0.50 have the highest mathematical potential to differentiate between high-achieving and low-achieving students.
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation_english: On norm-referenced tests, items with a difficulty index around 0.50 are preferred because they maximize score variance. When half the examinees pass and half fail an item, the item reaches its maximum mathematical capacity to differentiate between high-performing and low-performing students.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। मानक-संदर्भित परीक्षणों में, 0.50 के आसपास कठिनाई सूचकांक वाली वस्तुएं पसंद की जाती हैं क्योंकि ये स्कोर भिन्नता को अधिकतम करती हैं। जब आधे परीक्षार्थी एक वस्तु में पास होते हैं और आधे फेल होते हैं, तो वह वस्तु उच्च-प्राप्त करने वाले और निम्न-प्राप्त करने वाले छात्रों के बीच भेद करने की अपनी अधिकतम गणितीय क्षमता तक पहुँच जाती है।
questions.topic: Educational Measurement Concepts Tools and Techniques

questions.question_hindi:
58. भेदभाव सूचकांक (D) की गणना के लिए निम्नलिखित सूत्र पर विचार करें:
D = (Ru - Rl) / N
जहाँ Ru उच्च समूह में सही उत्तरों की संख्या है, Rl निम्न समूह में सही उत्तरों की संख्या है, और N एक समूह में छात्रों की संख्या है।
यदि एक आइटम को उच्च समूह में 25 छात्रों द्वारा (N=30) और निम्न समूह में 15 छात्रों द्वारा (N=30) सही उत्तर दिया गया है, तो भेदभाव सूचकांक क्या होगा:
questions.source: AI-generated from supplied reference material; Educational Measurement Concepts Tools and Techniques
questions.subject: Educational Policies & Measurement
questions.question_english:
58. Consider the following formula for calculating the discrimination index (D):
D = (Ru - Rl) / N
Where Ru is the number of correct responses in the upper group, Rl is the number of correct responses in the lower group, and N is the number of students in one group.
If an item is answered correctly by 25 students in the upper group (N=30) and by 15 students in the lower group (N=30), what is the discrimination index?
questions.explanation_english: The discrimination index is calculated by subtracting the number of correct responses in the lower group from the number of correct responses in the upper group and then dividing by the total number of students in one group. In this case, D = (25 - 15) / 30 = 0.33. This indicates that the item effectively differentiates between the two groups.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। भेदभाव सूचकांक को निम्न समूह में सही उत्तरों की संख्या को उच्च समूह में सही उत्तरों की संख्या से घटाकर और फिर एक समूह में छात्रों की कुल संख्या से विभाजित करके गणना की जाती है। इस मामले में, D = (25 - 15) / 30 = 0.33। यह दर्शाता है कि आइटम दोनों समूहों के बीच प्रभावी रूप से भेद करता है।
questions.topic: Educational Measurement Concepts Tools and Techniques
key_facts: The formula for discrimination index helps in understanding item effectiveness.
Printed answer key: (B) 0.33

questions.question_english: As a Principal reviewing an item analysis report for a mid-term examination, what action should you recommend for an item that has a difficulty index of 0.15 and a discrimination index of -0.20?
options_english: Retain the item in the exam as it effectively challenges the brightest high-achieving students
Move the item to the very beginning of the exam paper to help build student confidence early
Reject or completely rewrite the item because it is psychometrically flawed and confusing
Retain the item unchanged in the paper but adjust its individual scoring weightage value
questions.explanation_english: An item with a low difficulty index of 0.15 and a negative discrimination index of -0.20 is both extremely difficult and psychometrically inverse. It penalizes high-achieving students while favoring lower performers, indicating flawed construction or incorrect keying, and should be rejected or completely rewritten.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। एक वस्तु जिसका कठिनाई सूचकांक 0.15 और नकारात्मक विभेदन सूचकांक -0.20 है, वह अत्यधिक कठिन और मनोमिति से विपरीत है। यह उच्च प्रदर्शन करने वाले छात्रों को दंडित करता है जबकि निम्न प्रदर्शन करने वालों को लाभ पहुंचाता है, जो दोषपूर्ण निर्माण या गलत कुंजीकरण को इंगित करता है, और इसे अस्वीकार या पूरी तरह से फिर से लिखा जाना चाहिए।
questions.topic: Educational Measurement Concepts Tools and Techniques
key_facts: A low difficulty index with a negative discrimination index indicates flawed items.

questions.question_english: Questionnaires are a common tool of measurement in educational research and administration. Which of the following is a primary limitation of using a closed-ended questionnaire?

questions.explanation_english: Closed-ended questionnaires limit respondents to fixed, predetermined response options, preventing individuals from elaborating on their answers or expressing complex, nuanced viewpoints. questions.question_english: Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion and the other is labelled as Reason (R). Assertion: A test cannot be valid unless it is reliable. Reason (R): Reliability guarantees that a test measures exactly what it intends to measure.
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation_english: Reliability is a necessary precondition for validity, meaning a test cannot be valid unless it produces consistent scores across administrations. However, high reliability alone does not guarantee validity, because a test can consistently measure the wrong attribute. Validity specifically measures whether an instrument accurately assesses its intended theoretical construct.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। विश्वसनीयता वैधता के लिए एक आवश्यक पूर्वापेक्षा है, जिसका अर्थ है कि एक परीक्षण तब तक वैध नहीं हो सकता जब तक कि यह प्रशासन के दौरान सुसंगत स्कोर उत्पन्न न करे। हालाँकि, उच्च विश्वसनीयता अकेले वैधता की गारंटी नहीं देती है, क्योंकि एक परीक्षण लगातार गलत विशेषता को माप सकता है। वैधता विशेष रूप से यह मापती है कि क्या एक उपकरण अपने इच्छित सैद्धांतिक निर्माण का सही मूल्यांकन करता है।

key_facts: Reliability is necessary for validity.
High reliability does not guarantee validity.
Printed answer key: (C) A is true but R is false

questions.question_english: Which of the following accurately describes the relationship between assessment and evaluation?
options_english: Assessment is strictly summative and product-oriented, whereas evaluation is formative and ongoing
Assessment and evaluation are defined as fully interchangeable terms in modern educational policy
Assessment is formative and process-oriented, whereas evaluation is summative and product-oriented
Assessment provides descriptive value judgments, whereas evaluation merely collects objective data
questions.explanation_english: Assessment is an ongoing, formative process focused on gathering descriptive feedback during the learning cycle to diagnose weaknesses and enhance student understanding. Conversely, evaluation is typically summative and product-oriented, occurring at the conclusion of instruction to make definitive value judgments, award final grades, and certify overall educational outcomes against standards.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। आकलन एक निरंतर, प्रक्रिया-उन्मुख प्रक्रिया है जो सीखने के चक्र के दौरान वर्णात्मक फीडबैक एकत्रित करने पर केंद्रित होती है ताकि कमजोरियों का निदान किया जा सके और छात्र की समझ को बढ़ाया जा सके। इसके विपरीत, मूल्यांकन आमतौर पर समापनात्मक और उत्पाद-उन्मुख होता है, जो निर्देश के अंत में होता है ताकि निश्चित मूल्य निर्णय किए जा सकें, अंतिम ग्रेड दिए जा सकें और मानकों के खिलाफ समग्र शैक्षिक परिणामों को प्रमाणित किया जा सके।

Consider the following types of measurement errors:
I. Random Errors
II. Systematic Errors
III. Sampling Errors
Which type of error consistently affects scores in the same direction (e.g., all scores are inflated by 5 points) and primarily impacts test validity rather than reliability?

questions.explanation_english: Systematic errors consistently shift measurement scores in one direction, such as adding fixed points to all results. questions.question_english: During the standardization of a psychological test, the term "norms" refers to:
options_english: The standardized and strict administrative rules required for conducting the test in classrooms
The ethical principles and professional guidelines established for interpreting raw test scores
The average or typical score performance exhibited by a designated reference normative group
The minimum quantitative passing cutoff score strictly required to demonstrate subject mastery
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is c. In standardized testing, norms represent the typical baseline performance established by a representative reference group. Raw scores earned by individuals are compared against these standardized norms to derive relative meaning, enabling educators to determine where a student stands in comparison to a broader peer population.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। मानकीकृत परीक्षण में, मानक एक प्रतिनिधि संदर्भ समूह द्वारा स्थापित सामान्य आधारभूत प्रदर्शन का प्रतिनिधित्व करते हैं। व्यक्तियों द्वारा अर्जित कच्चे स्कोर को इन मानकीकृत मानकों के खिलाफ तुलना की जाती है ताकि सापेक्ष अर्थ निकाला जा सके, जिससे शिक्षकों को यह निर्धारित करने में मदद मिलती है कि एक छात्र व्यापक समकक्ष जनसंख्या की तुलना में कहाँ खड़ा है।
